_about: Innovation catalogue for step 10 (innovation-discovery). Entries are generic ideas; the agent tailors title, description, value and risk to the product and scores each against scoring-rubric.md. Keys are permanent: add entries, never rename or reuse a key.

entries.title: Smart form defaults
entries.description: Pre-fill fields from the user's last choice or profile so common tasks take fewer steps.

entries.title: Inline validation with fix hints
entries.description: Validate each field as it is filled and say how to fix it, instead of failing on submit.

entries.title: Save and resume long flows
entries.description: Let users leave a multi-step flow and continue later on any device.
entries.typical_risk: Stale drafts and data retention duties

entries.title: Undo instead of confirm dialogs
entries.description: Replace 'Are you sure?' dialogs with a short undo window after the action.
entries.typical_risk: Side effects that cannot be undone, such as sent emails

entries.title: Command palette
entries.description: Keyboard-driven search over every action and record for power users.

entries.title: Guided empty states
entries.description: Explain what belongs on an empty screen and offer the first action.

entries.title: Skeleton loading screens
entries.description: Show the page layout immediately while data loads to cut perceived wait.

entries.title: Accessible design system
entries.description: Shared components that meet WCAG 2.2 AA by default.

entries.title: Dark mode
entries.description: A dark colour theme that follows the device setting.
entries.typical_risk: Contrast regressions in images and charts

entries.title: Plain-language microcopy pass
entries.description: Rewrite labels, errors and confirmations in plain language tested with real users.

entries.title: Visual availability calendar
entries.description: Show free slots across days at a glance with the soonest option highlighted.

entries.title: Multilingual interface
entries.description: Serve the interface in the user's language, with translations managed outside the code.

entries.title: Guided onboarding checklist
entries.description: A short checklist that walks new users to their first success.

entries.title: Natural-language search
entries.description: Let users search with plain questions instead of exact keywords.
entries.typical_risk: Confident wrong answers; cost per query

entries.title: Conversational assistant
entries.description: A chat assistant that answers questions and completes simple tasks in the product.

entries.title: Chat or voice booking assistant
entries.description: Book, move or cancel appointments by chat or phone voice agent.

entries.title: Document data extraction
entries.description: Read uploaded forms and documents and fill fields automatically for review.

entries.title: Automatic summaries
entries.description: Summarise long threads, records or reports for quick review.

entries.title: Suggested replies
entries.description: Offer short reply suggestions to staff answering messages.
entries.typical_risk: Tone or factual errors sent to customers

entries.title: Anomaly detection
entries.description: Flag unusual transactions, readings or behaviour for human review.

entries.title: Demand forecasting
entries.description: Predict demand by day and hour to plan stock or staff.

entries.title: No-show risk prediction
entries.description: Score each booking's no-show risk so staff can remind or overbook carefully.
entries.typical_risk: Bias against patient groups; needs history

entries.title: AI content moderation
entries.description: Screen user-posted text and images before publishing.

entries.title: Automatic categorisation
entries.description: Tag incoming items such as tickets or expenses into categories automatically.

entries.title: Writing assistance in forms
entries.description: Help users draft descriptions, listings or messages.

entries.title: Agent-run back-office workflows
entries.description: Let an AI agent carry out multi-step back-office tasks under human approval.

entries.title: Automatic reminders
entries.description: Send reminders before due dates or appointments on the user's chosen channel.

entries.title: Waitlist with automatic offers
entries.description: When a slot or item frees up, offer it to the next person on the waitlist.

entries.title: One-tap reschedule links
entries.description: Include a secure link in messages that lets people move their booking.

entries.title: Recurring bookings and orders
entries.description: Set up repeating appointments, orders or tasks once.

entries.title: Rule-based approvals
entries.description: Approve routine requests automatically when they meet set rules; route the rest.

entries.title: Document generation
entries.description: Produce letters, invoices or certificates from templates and data.

entries.title: Automatic follow-ups
entries.description: Send a follow-up message after a visit, order or support case.

entries.title: Pre-visit digital intake
entries.description: Collect forms and consents before the visit instead of on paper at reception.

entries.title: Self-service data import
entries.description: Let customers import their existing data from CSV or other tools.

entries.title: Scheduled reports
entries.description: Email recurring reports to managers automatically.

entries.title: SLA timers and escalation
entries.description: Track deadlines on cases and escalate before they are missed.

entries.title: Smart payment retries
entries.description: Retry failed recurring payments at good times and prompt for new card details.

entries.title: Automation bridge to legacy systems
entries.description: Automate data entry into legacy systems that have no API.
entries.typical_risk: Brittle when the legacy UI changes

entries.title: Usage dashboard
entries.description: Show key usage numbers to the business owner in one page.

entries.title: Funnel analytics
entries.description: Track where users drop out of key flows such as sign-up or booking.

entries.title: Capacity utilisation report
entries.description: Show how full calendars, rooms or vehicles are, by hour and resource.

entries.title: Cohort retention analysis
entries.description: Measure how many users come back by sign-up month.

entries.title: A/B testing
entries.description: Compare two versions of a page or flow with real traffic.

entries.title: In-product feedback and NPS
entries.description: Ask a short satisfaction question after key moments.

entries.title: Revenue analytics
entries.description: Track revenue, churn and average order value over time.

entries.title: Self-service reporting
entries.description: Let customers build their own reports and exports.
entries.typical_risk: Performance on large data; data exposure

entries.title: Peer benchmarking
entries.description: Compare a customer's metrics with anonymised peers.

entries.title: Real-time operations board
entries.description: A live wall-board of today's queue, delays and capacity.

entries.title: Search insights
entries.description: Report what users search for and fail to find.

entries.title: Analytics export
entries.description: Let customers export raw data to their own warehouse.

entries.title: Churn prediction
entries.description: Flag customers likely to leave so teams can act early.

entries.title: Recent and favourite choices
entries.description: Put the user's recent and favourite options at the top.

entries.title: Preferred provider memory
entries.description: Remember the person's preferred professional or location and default to it.

entries.title: Personalised recommendations
entries.description: Recommend items based on behaviour and similar users.

entries.title: Notification preferences centre
entries.description: Let users choose which messages they get and on which channel.

entries.title: Adaptive content by segment
entries.description: Show different content to different user segments.

entries.title: Adaptive learning paths
entries.description: Adjust the next lesson to each learner's performance.

entries.title: Dynamic pricing
entries.description: Adjust prices by demand and time.

entries.title: Saved views and filters
entries.description: Let users save the filters and columns they use most.

entries.title: Family or household accounts
entries.description: One person manages bookings or accounts for dependants.

entries.title: Location-aware content
entries.description: Show nearby options and local information.

entries.title: Accessibility preferences
entries.description: Remember larger text, reduced motion and contrast choices.

entries.title: Suggested best slots
entries.description: Suggest slots that fit the person's past habits and the provider's gaps.

entries.title: Loyalty tiers
entries.description: Reward repeat customers with tiers and perks.

entries.title: Comments and mentions
entries.description: Discuss a record in place and mention colleagues.

entries.title: Shared workspaces
entries.description: Group people and content into shared spaces with roles.

entries.title: Real-time co-editing
entries.description: Several people edit the same item at once.

entries.title: Multi-step approvals
entries.description: Route items through ordered approvers with audit trail.

entries.title: Internal staff notes
entries.description: Staff add private notes to a customer or booking.

entries.title: Secure two-way messaging
entries.description: Customers and staff exchange secure messages instead of email.

entries.title: Shift handover log
entries.description: A structured log passed between shifts.

entries.title: Guest access for external parties
entries.description: Invite clients or vendors to see selected items.

entries.title: Activity feed
entries.description: Show recent changes by teammates.

entries.title: Video visits
entries.description: Hold appointments or sessions by video inside the product.
entries.typical_risk: Clinical and privacy rules for remote care

entries.title: Task assignment and due dates
entries.description: Assign follow-up tasks to people with due dates.

entries.title: Customer community
entries.description: A forum where customers help each other.

entries.title: Referral between providers
entries.description: Pass a customer to another provider with their history and consent.

entries.title: Passkey sign-in
entries.description: Sign in with device passkeys instead of passwords.
entries.typical_risk: Account recovery when devices are lost

entries.title: Multi-factor authentication
entries.description: Require a second factor for sign-in or sensitive actions.

entries.title: Passwordless magic links
entries.description: Sign in or confirm identity by a one-time link sent by email or SMS.

entries.title: Tamper-evident audit trail
entries.description: Record who viewed or changed what, in a log that cannot be edited.

entries.title: Consent management
entries.description: Record and honour each person's consents with history.
entries.typical_risk: Consents out of sync across systems

entries.title: Privacy self-service
entries.description: Let people download or delete their data themselves.
entries.typical_risk: Deleting data that must be retained

entries.title: Bot and abuse protection
entries.description: Stop automated sign-ups, scraping and fake bookings without CAPTCHAs for most users.

entries.title: Field-level encryption
entries.description: Encrypt the most sensitive fields so even database admins cannot read them.

entries.title: Active sessions and device list
entries.description: Show users where they are signed in and let them sign out remotely.

entries.title: Single sign-on for organisations
entries.description: Let organisations sign in with their own identity provider.

entries.title: Fraud scoring
entries.description: Score transactions for fraud risk before approval.

entries.title: Regional data residency
entries.description: Keep each customer's data in their chosen region.

entries.title: Remote identity verification
entries.description: Verify identity with a document and selfie check.
entries.typical_risk: Exclusion of people without ID; biometrics law

entries.title: Personal calendar sync
entries.description: Add bookings to Google, Apple or Outlook calendars with updates.

entries.title: Mobile wallet passes
entries.description: Put tickets or appointment details into Apple or Google Wallet.

entries.title: Maps and directions
entries.description: Link to directions and show parking or arrival information.

entries.title: Online deposits and payments
entries.description: Take a deposit or full payment when booking or ordering.

entries.title: Insurance eligibility check
entries.description: Check a patient's insurance cover before the visit.
entries.typical_risk: Coverage varies by insurer and country

entries.title: Health record exchange (FHIR)
entries.description: Exchange records with other health systems using the FHIR standard.

entries.title: Accounting system sync
entries.description: Post invoices and payments to the accounting system.

entries.title: CRM sync
entries.description: Keep customer records in step with the sales CRM.

entries.title: WhatsApp and SMS channels
entries.description: Message customers on the channels they already use.

entries.title: Public API and webhooks
entries.description: Let partners build on the product with an API and event webhooks.

entries.title: Embeddable booking widget
entries.description: Let partners or the client's own site embed booking.

entries.title: Book from search and maps
entries.description: Let people book directly from search-engine and map listings.

entries.title: Government or bank ID sign-in
entries.description: Sign in with a national eID or bank ID scheme where available.

entries.title: Edge caching and CDN
entries.description: Serve static assets and cacheable pages from the edge.

entries.title: Core Web Vitals budget
entries.description: Set and enforce load-time budgets in the build pipeline.

entries.title: Optimistic UI updates
entries.description: Show the result of an action immediately and reconcile with the server after.

entries.title: Automatic image optimisation
entries.description: Resize and compress images per device automatically.

entries.title: Predictive prefetching
entries.description: Load the likely next page in the background.

entries.title: Cached availability with live confirm
entries.description: Show availability from a fast cache and confirm against the master system at checkout.

entries.title: Autoscaling for peaks
entries.description: Scale capacity automatically for daily or campaign peaks.

entries.title: Queue-based load levelling
entries.description: Absorb bursts through queues so the core system is never overloaded.

entries.title: Dedicated search index
entries.description: Move search to a fast dedicated index.

entries.title: Graceful degradation
entries.description: Keep core flows usable when a dependency fails, with clear fallback messages.

entries.title: Real-user performance monitoring
entries.description: Measure real users' load times by device and network.

entries.title: Edge-rendered pages
entries.description: Render personalised pages close to the user.

entries.title: Carbon-aware hosting
entries.description: Choose regions and schedules that cut the product's carbon footprint.

entries.title: Installable web app (PWA)
entries.description: Let users install the web app on their home screen with app-like behaviour.

entries.title: Push notifications
entries.description: Send timely updates to the user's phone.

entries.title: Offline access to key info
entries.description: Keep the user's bookings, tickets or documents available without signal.

entries.title: Offline data capture with sync
entries.description: Capture data in the field offline and sync later.

entries.title: Native mobile app
entries.description: A native iOS and Android app.

entries.title: Biometric unlock
entries.description: Unlock the app with fingerprint or face.

entries.title: Camera document capture
entries.description: Photograph documents with automatic cropping.

entries.title: SMS fallback for low-connectivity users
entries.description: Confirm or change key actions by SMS reply.

entries.title: QR code check-in
entries.description: Check in on arrival by scanning a QR code.

entries.title: Location-based arrival notice
entries.description: Tell staff when the customer is nearby.

entries.title: Wearable integration
entries.description: Use data or reminders on smartwatches.

entries.title: Low-bandwidth mode
entries.description: A lighter version of key pages for slow networks.

entries.title: Self-service kiosk mode
entries.description: A locked-down tablet mode for walk-in customers.

entries.title: Post-visit reviews
entries.description: Ask for a rating after a visit or order and route low scores to staff.

entries.title: Recall and re-engagement campaigns
entries.description: Invite customers back when a periodic visit or renewal is due.

entries.title: Progress and achievements
entries.description: Show progress, streaks and achievements to motivate use.

entries.title: Customer referral programme
entries.description: Reward customers who refer others.

entries.title: Educational content hub
entries.description: Short guides that answer common customer questions.

entries.title: Newsletter with segments
entries.description: Send updates to opted-in customers by segment.

entries.title: Social proof cues
entries.description: Show ratings and popularity where users decide.

entries.title: Win-back offers
entries.description: Offer lapsed customers a reason to return.
entries.typical_risk: Training customers to wait for offers

entries.title: Milestone messages
entries.description: Celebrate anniversaries or goals reached.

entries.title: Events and webinars
entries.description: Host events customers can register for.

entries.title: Reminders for family members
entries.description: Let a carer receive reminders for a dependant's appointments.

entries.title: Contextual tips
entries.description: Short tips that appear when a user first meets a feature.

entries.title: Preventive care or maintenance nudges
entries.description: Prompt people about preventive actions based on their history.

entries.title: Admin console
entries.description: A back-office screen for staff to manage records, settings and users.

entries.title: Feature flags
entries.description: Turn features on per customer or percentage without redeploying.

entries.title: Staff rota and capacity management
entries.description: Plan staff shifts against forecast demand.

entries.title: Controlled overbooking
entries.description: Allow a set level of overbooking where no-shows are predictable.
entries.typical_risk: Long waits when everyone turns up

entries.title: Public status page
entries.description: Tell customers about outages and maintenance.

entries.title: Integrated support desk
entries.description: Handle customer questions with context from the product.

entries.title: Self-service help centre
entries.description: Answer common questions with searchable help articles.

entries.title: Bulk actions for staff
entries.description: Apply one change to many records at once.

entries.title: Resource and room booking
entries.description: Book rooms or equipment alongside people.

entries.title: Observability and alerting
entries.description: Logs, metrics and traces with alerts on user-facing failures.

entries.title: Data quality checks
entries.description: Detect duplicates, gaps and mismatches between systems.

entries.title: Multi-location support
entries.description: Run several branches with shared and local settings.

entries.title: Tested disaster recovery
entries.description: Regular restore drills against defined recovery targets.
